integrity: Finite arithmetic and simplicial verification supplement an all-q combinatorial proof; possible unindexed equivalent literature remains an originality risk.
scientific_limitations: Three coordinates, inclusive scale two, cyclic rotation; all alphabets q>=3. No ambient all-q homotopy claimed. The fixed-point graph is a homotopy model, not an asserted simplicial isomorphism.
title: Cyclic-coordinate geometric fixed points of multinary Hamming Rips complexes
